usdRate.sourceName: Bank of Japan, USD/JPY spot rate at 9:00 JST, Tokyo market

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Trading Economics, citing Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications CPI (secondary source)
inflation_cpi.note: Headline CPI 2.1% year on year in September 2026 (1.9% in August); core CPI excluding fresh food also 2.1%. The Statistics Bureau page links only to e-Stat tables.

inflation_projection.sourceName: Bank of Japan 2% price stability target
inflation_projection.note: The BOJ targets 2% and is raising rates to hold inflation there, so we plan with 2%.

policy_rate.sourceName: Bank of Japan, Statement on Monetary Policy, 30 October 2026
policy_rate.note: Uncollateralized overnight call rate guided to remain at around 1.25% (8-1 vote).

savings_account_rate.sourceName: Bank of Japan, average interest rates posted by type of deposit (ordinary deposits)
savings_account_rate.note: Average posted ordinary deposit rate 0.331% in October 2026.

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: Bank of Japan, average posted time deposit rates (under 3 million yen, 3 months)

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: Bank of Japan, average posted time deposit rates (under 3 million yen, 1 year)

dps_rate.note: The BOJ stopped publishing installment savings rates in 2022; banks offer installment time deposits but no average rate is published. The 5-year time deposit posted average is 0.748% (October 2026).

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: Bank of Japan, average interest rates on new time deposits (total)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Average on all new time deposits; ordinary deposits average 0.33%. World Bank FR.INR.DPST stops in 2017.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.sourceName: Ministry of Finance, JGBs for individuals: October 2026 offering rates
sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: Fixed 5-year retail JGB, October 2026 offering (subscriptions 8-30 October, issued 16 November): 2.39% a year before tax (1.9045% after 20.315% tax). Fixed 3-year 2.07%, floating 10-year 2.05% initial.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics, Japan 3-month bill yield (secondary source)

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: Ministry of Finance, JGB interest rates (yield curve)

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: Ministry of Finance, JGB interest rates (yield curve)

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: Ministry of Finance, JGBs for individuals (tax on interest)
tax_bank_interest.note: Interest on deposits and bonds is taxed separately at 20.315% (15.315% national including reconstruction surtax plus 5% local), withheld at source.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: Ministry of Finance, JGBs for individuals (tax on interest)
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: Retail JGB interest is taxed at 20.315%; some holders (for example people with disabilities) can claim exemption.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: Financial Services Agency, deposit insurance (payoff) page
deposit_insurance_limit.note: Principal up to 10 million yen per depositor per institution plus interest; settlement deposits fully protected.

credit_card_rate_cap.sourceName: Interest Rate Restriction Act (Act No. 100 of 1954), Article 1, e-Gov law database
credit_card_rate_cap.note: Legal caps: 20% a year on principal under 100,000 yen, 18% from 100,000 to under 1 million yen, 15% from 1 million yen; 18% used for typical card balances.

equity_return_low.sourceName: Retail fixed 5-year JGB 2.39% (1.90% after 20.315% tax), October 2026; 5-year JGB 2.24%
equity_return_low.note: Low case close to the after-tax safe rate of about 1.9%.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Retail fixed 5-year JGB 2.39% (1.90% after 20.315% tax), October 2026; 5-year JGB 2.24%
equity_return_base.note: After-tax safe rate of about 1.9% plus a 3.6-point premium; TOPIX had a strong decade, but valuations are higher now.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Retail fixed 5-year JGB 2.39% (1.90% after 20.315% tax), October 2026; 5-year JGB 2.24%
equity_return_high.note: High case near TOPIX's 10-year total return.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Bank of Japan USD/JPY spot (158.00 on 28 Oct 2026); World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat dollar gold and some yen recovery from historically weak levels.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Bank of Japan USD/JPY spot (158.00 on 28 Oct 2026); World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF
gold_return_base.note: Dollar gold trend of about 4% with no further expected yen depreciation.

gold_return_high.sourceName: Bank of Japan USD/JPY spot (158.00 on 28 Oct 2026); World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF
gold_return_high.note: High case with strong dollar gold and further yen weakness.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: BOJ posted 1-year time deposit 0.486% less 20.315% tax
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: bank time deposits only, after tax.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Retail fixed 5-year JGB 2.39% (1.90% after 20.315% tax), October 2026; 5-year JGB 2.24%
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: mix of retail JGBs (1.9% after tax) and deposits (0.4% after tax), about 1.5%.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: locking in 10-year JGB yields, about 2.2-2.3% after tax.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No industry-wide life claim settlement ratio was found from the FSA or the life insurance association within this pass.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life is widely sold, but no published per-1,000-yen premium rates by age were retrieved in this pass.

health_hospitalisation_cost.sourceName: Japan Institute of Life Insurance, Survey on Life Security (FY2025)
health_hospitalisation_cost.note: Average total out-of-pocket cost of a hospital stay 187,000 yen (24,300 yen a day), after the high-cost medical expense benefit; includes meals and private-room charges.

health_premium_table.note: Japanese private medical insurance pays daily and surgery benefits rather than a cover limit, so premiums per 100,000 yen of cover are not published.

oop_health_share.note: Figure is for 2023 (older than 2025); latest World Bank value.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Bank of Japan 2% target; national fee schedule for medical care
goal_inflation_health.note: Medical prices follow the regulated national fee schedule, so we plan with the 2% target.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Bank of Japan 2% target; tuition support for high school
goal_inflation_education.note: Public tuition support has held education prices down, so we plan slightly below the target.

life_expectancy.note: World Bank figure is for 2024 (older than 2025). MHLW 2025 abridged life table: men 81.35, women 87.33.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare, 2025 Abridged Life Table (Table 1, remaining life expectancy at main ages)
life_table_remaining.note: Official figures by sex for 2025; MHLW does not publish both sexes combined, so totals are the mean of men and women.

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 51.04 (2025, World Bank), 65.2 (2040) and 70.7 (2065, populationpyramid.net/japan/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Japan Pension Service, Old-age Basic Pension eligibility
retirement_age_default.note: Basic pension from 65 (early from 60, deferred to 75) for men and women. Employers must set any mandatory retirement age at 60 or above and keep staff employed to 65 if they wish.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: National Public Service Act, Article 81-6 and supplementary provisions (Act No. 61 of 2021), e-Gov law database
retirement_age_government.note: National civil servants' mandatory retirement age is 65 in the Act; transitional ages are 62 (April 2025 to March 2027), 63 (to March 2029), 64 (to March 2031) and 65 from April 2031, so 65 applies to anyone born after 1975.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: BOJ posted 1-year time deposit 0.486% less tax
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: time deposits only after tax.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: 1-year JGB 1.66% (30 October 2026) less 20.315% tax, about 1.3%; 3-month bill 1.21%
retirement_return_base.note: Base case below the after-tax 1-year government yield (about 1.3%), allowing for part held in deposits.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: Retail fixed 5-year JGB 2.39% (1.90% after 20.315% tax), October 2026; 5-year JGB 2.24%
retirement_return_high.note: High case: laddered retail and 5-year JGBs, about 1.8-1.9% after tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Retail fixed 5-year JGB 2.39% (1.90% after 20.315% tax), October 2026; 5-year JGB 2.24%
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix if equities only match bonds.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Retail fixed 5-year JGB 2.39% (1.90% after 20.315% tax), October 2026; 5-year JGB 2.24%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: roughly half equity at 5.5% and half bonds at 1.5-2.3%, held in tax-free NISA or iDeCo where possible.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Retail fixed 5-year JGB 2.39% (1.90% after 20.315% tax), October 2026; 5-year JGB 2.24%
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case with the equity high case.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Confirmed absent: Japan has no non-contributory old-age pension open to people planning today. The Japan Pension Service states the Old-age Basic Pension requires a qualifying period of at least 10 years of contributions or exemptions (https://www.nenkin.go.jp/service/jukyu/seido/roureinenkin/jukyu-yoken/20150401-01.html); people without a pension rely on means-tested public assistance, which is not an old-age pension.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Confirmed absent: no non-contributory old-age pension exists; the Old-age Basic Pension requires at least 10 years of contributions or exemptions (Japan Pension Service, https://www.nenkin.go.jp/service/jukyu/seido/roureinenkin/jukyu-yoken/20150401-01.html).

gratuity_rule.note: Confirmed absent: Japan has no statutory gratuity. The Labor Standards Act, Article 89(iii-2), requires work rules to cover retirement allowances only where the employer establishes one (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049); amounts are set by each employer's rules.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Japan Pension Service, Old-age Basic Pension amount (FY2026) and National Pension premium
public_pension_scheme.note: National Pension: residents join from 20 to under 60; FY2026 premium 17,920 yen a month (nenkin.go.jp premium page); full pension 847,300 yen a year (70,608 a month) after 40 years, pro rata, with 10 years minimum. Amounts are revised each April by price and wage indexation (with macro-economic slide); pensions are taxable. Employees also get the earnings-related Employees' Pension.

dps.note: Fixed monthly transfers into a time deposit; offered by most banks.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: Sold monthly from 10,000 yen; rate floor 0.05%; also fixed 3-year and floating 10-year types.

tbill_91d.note: Treasury discount bills are sold at auction to institutions and are not offered to individuals (holders are restricted to corporations; not confirmed from an official page in this pass).

tbond_5y.note: Individuals can buy newly issued JGBs at banks and brokers.

equity_fund.localName: 投資信託（インデックスファンド）
equity_fund.note: Widely held through tax-free NISA accounts and iDeCo private pensions.

gold.note: Gold bars and coins are freely bought; also gold accumulation plans.

insuranceComplaints.name: FSA Financial Services User Consultation Office
insuranceComplaints.note: Advice and referral; dispute resolution goes to the designated ADR body for life insurance.

pensionScheme.name: Japan Pension Service (National Pension and Employees' Pension)

publicHealthCover.name: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare (public medical insurance)
